description: "See what changed"
---

Use catch-up with a meaningful since timestamp. Summarize changed context/notes/work with attribution and sources; record histories contain revision authors/times, while Git diffs provide published content history. No notification inbox is created.

Read `.ddt/runtime/ASSISTANT.md` and `.ddt/runtime/WORKFLOWS.md`. Use its shared helper and revision/privacy rules. These commands are convenience entry points; the user can express the same intent naturally.
